tools.name: qualify_construct
tools.description: Return established C/S correspondence and engineering admission obligations for a KEX/BRAINK construct.

tools.name: challenge_construct
tools.description: Return falsification obligations while preserving failed results as evidence.

tools.name: runtime_self_test
tools.description: Check workbench truth-boundary and qualification mechanics.

tools.name: tl2_probe_pool
tools.description: Run the physical DNS/TCP Stratum subscribe probe against bitcoin.viabtc.io:3333 through mining-engine/carrier_tl2_bridge.py.

tools.name: tl2_guest_lane_once
tools.description: Bind one Unix-domain guest lane socket, read one line, validate mining.submit shape, and return the raw verdict.

tools.name: moebius_memory_contract
tools.description: Verify the 128KB layout, telemetry range, Moebius ring range, 64-byte alignment, and 124-byte packet capacity.

tools.name: tot_safety_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate an explicit action against authority, evidence, zeroless address/state and capability-escalation invariants; returns an append-only receipt.

tools.name: coordinate_register
tools.description: Register an evidence-backed nonzero coordinate/state record without silent overwrite.

tools.name: coordinate_list
tools.description: List coordinate records in deterministic address order.

tools.name: coordinate_promote
tools.description: Promote a coordinate revision only when explicit supersession evidence names the current revision.

tools.name: layer2_reconcile
tools.description: Reconcile two evidence-backed coordinate states; conflicts remain unresolved unless ordering is explicit.

tools.name: polarity_assess
tools.description: Compute the sum of opposing polarities; zero is permitted only as the computed assessment result.

tools.name: engineering_self_test
tools.description: Check the runtime presence of the safety kernel, coordinate directory, reconciler and zero-assessment rule.
